title: Fertility Goddess (No Effects)
description: While wandering through the woods, you come across a clearing. In the center of that clearing is the most gorgeous woman imaginable. She is a fertility goddess, the embodiment of Springtime, the time of year when all animals desire to mate. She causes all the plants around her to bloom and grow, and any animal upon which she casts her gaze is immediately overcome with the irresistible desire to mate. She suddenly turns her gaze towards you and searing lust stabs through your brain. Her pheromones wash over you like a tidal wave and you are powerless before her charms.
author: Mistress Shibby
